risks.title: Current derating not enforced in spec table
risks.rationale: Table lists 2 A/contact but a note caps simultaneous load at 1.5 A above +70 deg C; easy to miss.
risks.mitigation: Design to 1.5 A/contact under full load and high temperature.

risks.title: Operating temp ceiling +85 deg C may be marginal
risks.rationale: If the application exceeds +85 deg C the connector is out of spec.
risks.mitigation: Confirm worst-case ambient + self-heating stays under +85 deg C.

tasks.title: Confirm per-contact current budget under full load
